title: Can You Get Into Berghain?
lead: Test a fictional Berlin club-door night with outfit, queue and timed decisions.

outfit.question: First, choose your outfit for the night.

options.text: All black, subtle.
Neon mesh, glitter.
Jeans, sneakers.
A tailored suit.

group.question: How many people are you queuing with?

options.text: Just me.
Two of us.
Four, but we will split up.
A big group, all together.

randomPool.question: You are in the queue. It is a long wait. What are you doing?

options.text: Wait quietly and keep my phone away.
Take a selfie with the building.
Laugh loudly and narrate the queue.

randomPool.question: Someone in front offers you a drink. What do you do?

options.text: Politely decline and stay present.
Take it. It is party time.
Ask what the event is before deciding.

randomPool.question: The line is moving slowly. How do you handle it?

options.text: Stay patient and read the room.
Try to negotiate a shortcut.
Complain until everyone hears it.

randomPool.question: You reach the front. The bouncer asks what is on tonight.

options.text: I know the lineup and the room I want.
I do not know yet. I just want to dance.
Name a random headliner with confidence.

randomPool.question: You reach the front. The bouncer asks for your ID.

options.text: Hand over my physical ID calmly.
Ask which ID is needed, then check.
Pat my pockets. I forgot it.

randomPool.question: The bouncer studies the queue and gives you one second to speak.

options.text: Give a short, calm answer.
Say, 'I am not sure,' and wait.
Lead with, 'I am on the guest list.'

randomPool.question: The bouncer asks: Why do you want to go in?

options.text: I want to dance and hear the room.
The music matters to me tonight.
It is my friend's birthday.

randomPool.question: The bouncer asks what kind of night you planned.

options.text: A late night focused on the music.
I will see where the night goes.
I need to see everything immediately.

randomPool.question: One last check: what happens to your phone inside?

options.text: It stays away. I am here for the room.
It goes on silent and stays in my pocket.
I will get one quick photo inside.

vip.title: Stammgast
vip.message: The fictional door mood lines up with your choices. Welcome into the night.

success.title: Viel Spaß.
success.message: The fictional bouncer gives a small nod. You made it through this round.

fail.title: Heute leider nicht.
fail.message: The fictional door stays closed tonight. The result is a game, not a forecast.

shame.title: Raus hier.
shame.message: That route sent the fictional night sideways before the door could warm to you.

vip.title: The Quiet Regular
vip.reason: You kept the energy low and let the music do the talking.

vip.title: The Floor Reader
vip.reason: You read the room, answered cleanly and did not chase approval.

success.title: The Calm Entry
success.reason: You made enough grounded calls for this fictional door to open.

success.title: The Right Night
success.reason: Not perfect, but your choices fit this made-up night's mood.

fail.title: The Near Miss
fail.reason: A few good calls were not enough to turn the whole night around.

fail.title: The Wrong Turn
fail.reason: One noisy detour changed the tone before the final question.

shame.title: The Queue Static
shame.reason: The queue energy got louder than the plan, and the fictional door noticed.

shame.title: Too Much Signal
shame.reason: The night sent too many signals at once for this imaginary bouncer.
